The **9.9 Flash Sale** is here — bringing you unbeatable deals to refresh your home without breaking the bank. From **9 to 14 September 2025** , enjoy limited-time offers on selected chairs — while stocks last!


### ✨ What’s on Sale?


- **Saddle Bar Chair @ $99**
Perfect for your kitchen island, bar counter, or dining space. Sleek, sturdy, and stylish — at this price, it’s a steal.
- **Dakota Chairs (Set of 2) @ $199**
Comfort meets modern design. Whether you’re hosting dinner parties or upgrading your dining setup, this pair is the perfect addition.


### Shop Your Way


All deals are available in-store and online, so you can choose the most convenient way to shop.


### Don’t Miss Out!


The clock is ticking — deals run from **9–14 September 2025** , while stocks last.
